today.title: COULD IT HAPPEN TODAY?
lines: After the collapse, gusset plates were added to US bridge load ratings.
Adding weight to an old bridge now means re-checking its joints.
The beams were strong enough. The plates holding them together were not.

shots.caption: An eight-lane highway bridge fell into the Mississippi at rush hour.
A steel deck truss: beams joined at steel plates, called gussets.
The plates holding the beams were half as thick as they needed to be.
At 6:05 pm the plates at U10 tore apart.
For 40 years, weight was added. In 2003, the plates were photographed bowed.
Plates twice as thick would have held.
